mapper.select: SELECT id, post_id, image_url, image_key, sort_order FROM post_image WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND deleted = false ORDER BY sort_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_image (post_id, image_url, image_key, sort_order, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{postId}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageKey}, #{sortOrder}, NOW(), NOW(), false)
